name: Lark
direction: Young bright soprano; light New Zealand accent; springy rhythm and a clear ringing edge.
description: A young adult woman with a bright, high soprano speaking voice and a light New Zealand accent. A small breathy onset opens into clear ringing vowels. Springy energetic rhythm, playful rises, and decisive final words. Curious, quick-witted, and self-assured. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
